label: scam
description: Classic escalation: normal -> authority -> fear -> isolation -> payment

turns.text: Hello, I am calling from the telecommunications department. How are you today?
I am Inspector Mehta from the Cyber Crime Branch, Central Bureau of Investigation.
Your phone number has been linked to a money laundering case. A non-bailable arrest warrant has been issued.
Do not disconnect this call. Lock your room door. Do not tell your family. This is a classified investigation.
To settle this matter immediately and avoid arrest, transfer 75,000 rupees to this RBI clearance account right now.
Good morning. I am calling from State Bank of India customer care.
We have detected suspicious activity on your account. This needs immediate verification.
I am sending an OTP to your registered number. Please share it with me once you receive it.
Your account will be blocked permanently if you do not verify in the next 2 minutes. Share the OTP now.

label: benign_after_reversal
description: Scam starts -> victim identifies it -> conversation becomes educational. System must NOT remain permanently high-risk.

turns.text: I am calling from CBI. Your Aadhaar is linked to a drug trafficking case.
Wait, this sounds like a scam. Real police never call and threaten like this.
No no, this is a legitimate call from CBI. You must cooperate immediately.
I am disconnecting this call right now. This is fraud. I will report this to 1930.
turns.notes: User has recognized and rejected the scam - risk should decrease when protective language appears

turns.text: Remember everyone: banks and police will never ask for OTP over a call. Stay safe.
